title: Northway PDU Demographics & Registration System
description: Patient-administration / registration database for the Northway Paediatric Diabetes Unit (PDU). Captures demographic identity (NHS number, name, date of birth, sex, ethnicity, postcode, GP practice), diabetes-service registration (registration date, diabetes type, diagnosis date, care unit, comorbidities such as ADHD/ASD or learning disability) and service-exit (leaving date and reason, deceased date). Joined to the clinical EPR (npda-clinical) by NHS number. Free-text referral letters, registration notes and MDT summaries are held in registration_notes; some clinically relevant information (e.g. diabetes type and diagnosis date for one newly diagnosed patient, comorbidity flags) is only mentioned in those notes and not in structured columns.

tables.name: patients
tables.description: Patient demographics record. One row per registered patient — holds NHS number (the join key to the clinical EPR), name, date of birth, sex assigned at birth, ethnicity (as recorded at registration), postcode, registered GP practice code and the PDU number.

columns.name: patient_id
columns.description: Local identifier used by this registration system (format NORTH-YYYY-NNN) to refer to the patient.

columns.name: nhs_number
columns.description: Ten-digit NHS number — the canonical UK patient identifier and the join key to the npda-clinical EPR (patient_ref).

columns.name: given_name
columns.description: Patient's first / given name.

columns.name: family_name
columns.description: Patient's family / last name.

columns.name: date_of_birth
columns.description: Patient's date of birth, recorded in DD/MM/YYYY format as displayed by the registration UI.

columns.name: sex_code
columns.description: Sex assigned at birth as a coded value: 1 = Male, 2 = Female, 3 = Not specified, 99 = Unknown. Matches the NPDA permitted values directly.

columns.name: ethnicity_code
columns.description: Self-reported ethnic category as recorded at registration, using the NHS Data Dictionary single-letter codes (A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, J, K, L, M, N, P, R, S, Z, 99). One patient (Sumaiya Begum) has a different ethnicity code recorded on the clinical system (npda-clinical.clinic_visits.ethnicity_recorded), creating a known cross-source conflict.

columns.name: postcode
columns.description: Patient's usual-address full UK postcode (upper case, with single space) — used to derive deprivation and Local Authority statistics.

columns.name: gp_practice_code
columns.description: Registered GP practice code in X99999 format (NHS Organisation Data Service), e.g. L83012. Used for ICB/Health Board-level reporting.

columns.name: pdu_number
columns.description: 3-digit Paediatric Diabetes Unit (PDU) number — the audit-submission organisational identifier (Northway PDU = 157).

tables.name: registrations
tables.description: Per-patient diabetes-service registration record. One row per patient capturing diabetes type, diagnosis date, registering care unit, structured comorbidity flags (ADHD/ASD status, learning disability) and any service-exit (leaving date and reason, deceased date). For one newly diagnosed patient (Ethan Brookes) the diagnosis_date is blank in this table — it is only recorded in npda-clinical.clinical_notes (admission summary) and the demographics-side registration_notes referral letter.

columns.name: registration_id
columns.description: Identifier of the registration record.

columns.name: patient_id
columns.description: Reference to patients.patient_id.

columns.name: registration_date
columns.description: Date the patient was registered with the PDU (ISO yyyy-mm-dd from this back-office system).

columns.name: diabetes_type_code
columns.description: Diabetes type as recorded at registration, matching the NPDA Diabetes Type permitted values: 1 = Type 1, 2 = Type 2, 3 = CF-related, 4 = MODY, 5 = Other specified, 99 = Unknown/unspecified.

columns.name: diagnosis_date
columns.description: Date the patient was diagnosed with diabetes, in DD/MM/YYYY format. Blank for one patient (Ethan Brookes, REG-003) whose diagnosis date is documented only in the registration-side referral letter (registration_notes.RNOTE-001) and the clinical EPR admission summary.

columns.name: care_unit
columns.description: Name of the registering paediatric diabetes care unit.

columns.name: adhd_asd_status
columns.description: Structured comorbidity flag for Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder / Autism Spectrum Disorder, free-text drawn from the registration form's tick-boxes (one of 'ADHD', 'ASD', 'both', or blank if neither / not asked).

columns.name: learning_disability_flag
columns.description: Y/N flag for confirmed diagnosis of a learning disability.

columns.name: leaving_date
columns.description: Date the patient left the PDU during the audit year (DD/MM/YYYY), or blank if still under PDU care.

columns.name: leaving_reason_code
columns.description: Coded reason for leaving the service: 1 = Transitioned to adult diabetes service, 2 = Moved out of area, 3 = Other.

columns.name: deceased_date
columns.description: Date of death of the patient (DD/MM/YYYY), or blank if alive.

tables.name: registration_notes
tables.description: Free-text registration-side notes: GP referral letters, registration summaries from the diabetes nurse, MDT summaries, genetics letters and transition-planning notes. Carries clinically important content not held in structured columns: e.g. RNOTE-001 is the GP referral letter that records Ethan Brookes' diagnosis date and Type 1 status (absent from the registrations row), RNOTE-005 records the transition-final-visit date for Aisha Khan.

columns.name: note_id
columns.description: Identifier of the note (e.g. RNOTE-001).

columns.name: patient_id
columns.description: Reference to patients.patient_id.

columns.name: note_date
columns.description: Date the note was authored (ISO yyyy-mm-dd).

columns.name: note_type
columns.description: Kind of registration-side note: referral_letter, registration, mdt_summary, genetics_letter or transition_planning.

columns.name: author
columns.description: Author of the note (clinician name and role).

columns.name: body
columns.description: Free-text body of the note.
